# Sagent Behavioral Health

> Sagent Behavioral Health is a multi-state mental health provider network offering therapy, psychiatry, DBT, psychological testing, and substance use disorder treatment across 80+ locations in Iowa, Minnesota, Wisconsin, Missouri, and North Dakota.

Sagent operates a comprehensive behavioral health network with 600+ licensed therapists and psychiatrists. The organization accepts major insurance plans including Medicare and Medicaid, and provides both in-person and telehealth services across the Upper Midwest and beyond.

## Core Services

- [Mental Health Services](https://sagentbh.com/our-services): Comprehensive mental health services: therapy, psychiatry, DBT, and substance use disorder treatment
- [Therapy Services](https://sagentbh.com/our-services/therapy): Therapy services with 600+ therapists, EMDR, and telehealth available
- [Psychiatry & Medication Management](https://sagentbh.com/our-services/psychiatry-and-medication-management): Psychiatry services including medication management, assessment, and care coordination
- [Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT)](https://sagentbh.com/our-services/dialectical-behavior-therapy-dbt): DBT program for emotion regulation and behavioral health
- [Substance Use Disorder Treatment](https://sagentbh.com/our-services/substance-use-disorder-treatment): Outpatient SUD treatment with medication-assisted therapy options
- [Psychological Testing](https://sagentbh.com/our-services/psychological-testing): Psychological testing for ADHD, autism, behavioral and intellectual evaluation

## Clinic Locations & Access

- [Find a Mental Health Clinic](https://sagentbh.com/our-locations): Clinic locator for mental health services across 5 states
- [Iowa Mental Health Clinics](https://sagentbh.com/our-locations/iowa): Iowa clinic locations in Ankeny, Cedar Rapids, and Des Moines
- [Minnesota Mental Health Clinics](https://sagentbh.com/our-locations/minnesota): Minnesota clinics across Twin Cities, Northern and Southern regions
- [Wisconsin Mental Health Clinics](https://sagentbh.com/our-locations/wisconsin): Wisconsin clinic locations in Appleton, Eau Claire, and Green Bay
- [Telehealth](https://sagentbh.com/telehealth): Virtual therapy, psychiatry and addiction treatment via secure platform

## Specialty Mental Health Areas

- [Specialty Areas](https://sagentbh.com/specialty-areas): Mental health specialties including ADHD, anxiety, depression, and bipolar disorder
- [ADHD](https://sagentbh.com/specialty-areas/adhd): ADHD overview: symptoms, causes, and treatment options for adults and children
- [Anxiety Disorders](https://sagentbh.com/specialty-areas/anxiety): Anxiety disorders including generalized, social, separation anxiety and phobias
- [Anger Management](https://sagentbh.com/specialty-areas/anger-issues): Anger management: learn skills for emotional regulation and communication
- [Autism Spectrum Disorder](https://sagentbh.com/specialty-areas/autism): Autism spectrum disorder: symptoms, diagnosis, evaluation and therapy
